cost_note: Expected latency = graph walk + judge calls (llm_judge gate) + retry share x (LLM expansion + second walk), from live latencies measured in results/legal_llm_graph; not re-timed end to end.
protocol: Team legal_rag protocol. Gate signals, threshold rule, and combination were fixed before the held-out run; peakedness was chosen on development by how well it predicts first-pass misses (AUC 0.65 vs 0.51 for coverage). End to end, no gate clearly beats the single pass on development, where a retry changes Hit@5 for only 3 of 20 questions (the top-5 rank for 7), so development cannot validate a gate. The LLM expansion was designed on an earlier split overlapping held-out, so retry numbers are somewhat optimistic.
